player_prompt.intro: Udlala i-Tower of Hanoi ngama-disc {num_disks}. Kumele uhambise ama-disc kusuka embhoshongweni A kuya embhoshongweni C. Ukuze uhambise i-disc, thayipha umbhoshongo womthombo kanye nombhoshongo okuhloswe ngawo (isib., '[A C]). Qaphela ukuthi ungakwazi ukuhambisa kuphela idiski ephezulu yombhoshongo, nokuthi idiski enkulu ayikwazi ukufakwa kudiski encane. Ekuphendukeni ngakunye, thumela isinyathelo esisodwa.

invalid_move.empty_tower: Wazama ukuhambisa i-disk esuka embhoshongweni ongenalutho.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Wazama ukubeka idiski enkulu phezu kwediski encane.

outcome.turn_limit: Umkhawulo wokuphenduka ufinyelelwe. Ubekwe kahle {pct}% wama-disc eMbhoshongweni C.
